name: AIPing Model Router
description: Routes 'aiping:claw' model requests between your local Ollama model and AIPing cloud (Kimi-K2.5) using fast rule-based scoring.

aipingApiKey.title: AIPing API Key
aipingApiKey.description: Your AIPing API key. Get it at https://aiping.cn/user/user-center

localProxyUrl.title: Local Proxy URL
localProxyUrl.description: Ollama or local proxy base URL

localProxyKey.title: Local Proxy Key
localProxyKey.description: Optional auth key for the local proxy

localModel.title: Local Model Name
localModel.description: Name of the local model to use (auto-detected from Ollama at setup time)

routingThreshold.title: Routing Threshold
routingThreshold.description: 复杂度评分阈值 (0-100)。评分 >= 阈值 → 云端，< 阈值 → 本地。满分 100，默认 85 使约 90% 请求走本地。

fallbackToCloud.title: Fallback to Cloud
fallbackToCloud.description: Automatically fall back to cloud if local model fails or times out

localTimeoutMs.title: Local Model Timeout (ms)
localTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for local model requests before triggering fallback

preferCloudForTools.title: Tool-Use Routing Mode
preferCloudForTools.description: 决定工具调用如何路由：'code'（默认）= 仅代码写入类工具加分走云端，bash/read等简单工具走本地；'all' = 所有工具调用强制云端；false = 关闭工具路由。

workflowHintBoost.title: Workflow hint boost
workflowHintBoost.description: Optional small score bumps for certain multi-step or multi-file request shapes (never forces cloud). Default off to maximize local routing.
